title_en: Catalogue of Judicial Interpretations Issued by the Supreme People's Court before the End of 1999 to be Abolished (Third Batch)

articles.content_en:
Directory of Relevant Judicial Interpretations (Third Batch)
(Adopted at the 1119th session of the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court on June 16, 2000,
All judicial interpretations that shall be abolished in this directory shall no longer apply from July 25, 2000.)
Fa Shi [2000] No. 20
